title: Re-land the harness fix that never reached main: stop() awaits an already-exited child, so a boot failure exits 13 with no summary line
note: NEW / continuity correction. The 2026-10-03 round implemented this and its PR was not merged (its verify run failed on the flake fixed this round), so main is still pristine a2a44d4 and NONE of it exists: tools/smoke-test.mjs:89 is still `waitForHealth(url = baseUrl)` with no supervision parameter, there is no superviseServer(), startExtraServer still pipes stderr that nobody drains (lost diagnostics + pipe-fill deadlock), and stop() still awaits the `exit` event of a child that already exited. Measured in that round: 56222ms / exit 13 / 4 FAIL before, 558ms / exit 1 / 4 PASS after, with the bug re-inserted to confirm. tools/harness-selftest.mjs (npm run test:harness) is also absent. With this round's flake fixed, re-landing it should now clear verify. This is the highest-value next item and it is a known-good diff, not new design.

title: The playground recording panel read in the smoke suite waits for a condition that is already true, so under load it asserts on the pre-refresh DOM
note: Implemented this round. `#startRecordingBtn` renders the opening `goto` row, so `wait-for [data-testid=recording-step] visible` after clicking `#refreshRecordingBtn` returned immediately and `allTextContents` read the stale single-row panel. Proven with a probe on production wiring (real server.js, real browser, real /playground): under concurrent load the current sequence failed 3/3 with rows=["0. goto..."] and serverSteps=4 / serverActions [goto,click,fill,click] / 0 warnings -- the recorder was correct, the read was stale. Idle it passes 3/3, which is why it only shows up on a busy verify machine. Replaced both the refresh wait and the 1200ms post-delete sleep with observable post-conditions, and added `before > 1` so a stale read can no longer pass vacuously.

note: Premise corrected: the carried-over note said superviseServer()/waitForHealth(url, supervised) 'now exist and are wired'. title: Recording dedupe swallows distinct selectOption/press steps
note: Re-verified against HEAD this round, still present. server.js:7360-7366 compares only `previous.value === step.value`, but selectOption carries step.values (7329) and press carries step.key (7342) with step.value deleted, so a second selection on the same select inside 600ms is dropped and the recording replays the wrong option. Widen the comparison signature to [action, locator, value, values, key]. Needs a browser; chromium is installed in this round's worktree (under the run's HOME, so it does not persist to the next one).

title: A negative Playwright step duration is passed straight through to the API
note: Carried over unchanged; not reproduced this round. server.js:1196 (generated reporter) and server.js:1252 (flattenReportSteps) publish `step.duration` verbatim when it is a number, and tools/smoke-test.mjs:2850 asserts the contract is `null || >= 0`. server.js:2421 (`last?.duration ?? null`) reads the same value for the test level and must be handled in the same change. Observed once on a post-install cold chromium launch (durationMs: -885); the suspected WSL2 clock step was never proven and there is still no deterministic reproduction to drive a failing test from.

title: Audit the remaining smoke checks for fixed sleeps standing in for observable post-conditions
note: NEW, generalises what was proven this round. tools/smoke-test.mjs uses `wait-for { sleepMs }` as the only synchronisation in several places (~3931 800ms, ~3990 800ms, ~4094 1500ms) and the sibling playground check waits on `[data-testid='approval-row']` becoming visible after `#runWorkflowBtn` when a row from the previous workflow may still be on screen. Each is the same class of defect as this round's: a wait that can be satisfied by the pre-action state. Measure each under concurrent load before changing it -- idle runs hide every one of them, so do not change any site without a failure first.

title: npm test in a bare checkout does not tell you to run npm install
note: Re-scoped back to the original: the carried-over note said this was 'partly addressed as a side effect', but that was in the unmerged round, so on main nothing is addressed -- `npm test` in a worktree with no node_modules still polls the full 56s health budget and reports only `server did not become healthy`. Measured again at the start of this round: this worktree had no node_modules and npm install + chromium took minutes of the budget. Detect a missing node_modules up front and say `run npm install`. Lands naturally alongside the re-land item.

title: check() double-reports group-level and check-level SKIP as two lines
note: Carried over, re-confirmed against HEAD. tools/smoke-test.mjs:34-45 only recognises the bare string 'skip', so the `{ skip: reason }` return path the old note assumed still has to be added first. The group sites then call record('<group> checks','skip',...) and also return 'skip', so one skip prints twice and the tally counts it twice. Changing this moves the skipped count that other records' expected values depend on, so it wants its own round.

title: recorderLocatorCandidates double-escapes quotes into an invalid CSS selector
note: Re-read this round and still present: server.js:3845 and 3847 both do `.replaceAll('"', '\\\\"')`, which is the three-character replacement `\\"`, yielding `[name="a\\"b"]` -- an escaped backslash followed by an unescaped quote. Only elements whose name/id contains a quote are affected, so the input is rare. Per the operator rule on two parsers reading one value, the page_inspect path that builds the same selector has to be checked end-to-end in the same change.

title: The playground panel gives a reader no way to tell a stale render from a fresh one
note: NEW, the product-side observation behind this round's fix. renderRecording (public/assets/playground.js:414) replaces the rows with no marker of which recording revision produced them, so between clicking refresh and the fetch landing the panel silently shows the previous list -- which is what made the smoke check racy. Stamping the container with the rendered step count (or showing it as text) would make the state readable to a person as well as to automation. Deliberately not done this round: the proven defect was in the check, and a test hook in production code wants its own justification.

title: Recording nth note overwrites the ambiguous note
note: Rejected this round after confirming the two conditions cannot co-occur, which is what the carried-over note asked for. server.js:7345 sets the ambiguous note only when `!resolved.unique`, and server.js:7353 overwrites it only when `resolved.nth` is set -- but resolveRecordedLocator sets `nth: true` solely on the narrowing branch at 7251-7258, which returns `unique: true`. Every other return either omits nth or sets `unique: false`. So no step can take both branches and there is nothing to fix.

title: GitHub Actions CI 워크플로 추가 — 러너가 돌리는 검증 명령을 그대로 CI 로
note: 이 저장소에는 워크플로 파일이 없어 러너 PR 이 전부 "CI 검사 없음" 으로 막힌다. 러너가 이미 돌리는 검증 명령(build·vet·test)을 그대로 .github/workflows/ci.yml 로 옮겨라. 이 파일은 보호 경로라 사람 승인을 받는다.
